AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene in Rearing Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene in Rearing Animals.

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

6. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Constructing Water Retention Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Constructing Water Retention Structures.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Establishment Planting Site? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Establishment Planting Site.

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hygiene in Rearing Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Knitting Skills 10 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
